headline: Techera Engineering wins Rs 7.51 crore aerospace order
summary: Techera Engineering secured a Rs 7.51 crore order for rear fuselage and air intake assembly from a domestic public sector entity. The 5-year contract adds to recent wins in Q2FY27.

headline: Vdeal System wins Rs 14.54 lakh order from Nalco
summary: Vdeal System secures a confirmed work order worth Rs 14.54 lakh from Nalco for power distribution systems. The order adds to the company's backlog, though it is small relative to the massive Rs 30,00,202.47 crore inflow recorded in Q1FY27.

headline: Positron Energy secures Rs 25.0 crore LNG supply order
summary: Positron Energy disclosed a new Rs 25.0 crore order for spot LNG supply in September 2026. This follows a recent Rs 33.0 crore GSPA, bringing total Q2FY27 inflows to Rs 58.0 crore.

symbol: SAB Events & Governance Now Media Limited

headline: SAB Events board to approve merger, preferential issue
summary: SAB Events & Governance Now Media Ltd board meets on September 18, 2026, to consider a preferential issue and the merger of Sri Adhikari Brothers Digital Network Private Limited.

headline: RPG Life Sciences completes API slump sale
summary: RPG Life Sciences confirms completion of slump sale of APIs and intermediates business to Raghava Life Sciences, effective September 16, 2026.

headline: SMC Global Securities files draft for ₹750 cr NCD issue
summary: SMC Global Securities Limited has submitted a draft prospectus to SEBI for a public issue of secured, rated, listed, redeemable non-convertible debentures. The base issue size is up to ₹7,500 lakh with an oversubscription option of the same amount.

headline: Vedant Fashions CFO Rahul Murarka resigns
summary: Vedant Fashions' Co CFO Rahul Murarka has resigned effective November 14 to pursue other opportunities, marking a key leadership change at the ethnic wear company.

headline: AJC Jewel targets ₹450 crore FY27 revenue with 50% CAGR
summary: AJC Jewel Manufacturers targets ₹450 crore standalone revenue by FY27, aiming for 50% CAGR over 3 years. UAE acquisition set to consolidate from Q3.

headline: W.J. Towell files annulment petition against Blue Star
summary: W.J. Towell has filed an annulment petition in the Dubai Court of Appeal against an arbitration award won by Blue Star, escalating a legal dispute between the two parties.

headline: Stocks in News: Vikram Solar, Saatvik, NBCC
summary: Vikram Solar and Saatvik Green Energy lead with mega orders. NBCC expands to Australia, while Cupid promoters buy heavily. Check the full list.

headline: Exide Industries signs EEA battery deal with ExCom
summary: Exide Industries enters strategic cooperation with Germany's ExCom Energy Solutions to develop industrial battery business across the European Economic Area.

headline: India to introduce fee for UPI merchant transactions
summary: India plans to introduce a fee on merchant transactions conducted through its digital payments network to ensure the financial sustainability of the system.

headline: South Indian Bank appoints Mahesh Pai as MD & CEO
summary: South Indian Bank has appointed Mahesh Muralidhar Pai as MD & CEO effective October 1, 2026. He will serve as Officer on Special Duty from September 16 to facilitate transition.

headline: UPI to levy 0.4% MDR on transactions above ₹2,000
summary: UPI is set to introduce a 0.4% MDR on transactions above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300, effective October 15. This could create a ₹22,000 crore revenue pool by FY28, per a newspaper report.

headline: Yes Bank moves SC against Fortis share-sale audit
summary: Yes Bank has moved the Supreme Court against a Fortis share-sale audit. Axis Bank and Fortis Healthcare may also file appeals, according to a newspaper report.
